data.current_description:
Store one webhook URL on the account so you do not have to send `X-Webhook-URL` on every call. Free.

**There is nothing to subscribe to.** That one URL receives every event for the account — `enrichment.completed`, `enrichment.failed`, `enrichment.no_data_found`. No `events` array, no per-event filtering.

Your signing secret is not returned here; it lives in the API Panel, where you can also rotate it.
data.description_suggestion: Configures a webhook URL for the account to receive enrichment event notifications. The stored URL will receive all events for the account without per-event filtering: `enrichment.completed`, `enrichment.failed`, and `enrichment.no_data_found`. Accepts a webhook URL in the request body. Returns the stored configuration. This endpoint is free and does not consume credits. Note: The webhook signing secret is managed separately in the API Panel and is not returned by this endpoint. Replaces any previously configured webhook URL.
